resources.string:
Lynko is a local-only companion app. Everything happens between your phone and your paired desktop over your home network — no cloud, no account, and no tracking or analytics.

Permissions and what they are used for:
• Screen capture (media projection) — only while you are mirroring your screen. Capture stops when you stop mirroring or disconnect.
• Accessibility service — only to carry gestures typed or performed on your paired desktop to the phone. Nothing is read from other apps.
• Notification listener — only to display your phone notifications on the paired desktop while you are connected.
• Storage (media / files) — only when you share or save a file through Lynko.
• Microphone / audio capture — only when you press Audio on the desktop, and only to stream the device’s playback audio to that paired desktop.

No personal data is sent anywhere outside your network. You can revoke any permission at any time in Android settings, and all stored settings (PIN, preferences) stay on this device.
